blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation using the same parameters. This removes the independent fake network while retaining S2-Avatar's frozen reference teacher, Self-Replay Forcing, and perceptual regularization. We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos using three backbone evaluations per block and a one-step spatial Refiner, with a 70-case human study and a 320-case StreamAV-Bench comparison. Compared with S2-Avatar, APEX achieves higher video instruction fulfillment on the Progressive track (3.856 versus 3.831) and higher visual aesthetics across both tracks (0.641898 versus 0.632606). Human raters favor APEX most strongly on instruction following, with +30.0% net preference, followed by consistency and video quality at +4.3% each. Motion quality favors S2-Avatar, audiovisual synchronization is predominantly tied, and usability is unchanged. Separate measurements under matched training settings show 4.4% lower peak allocated GPU memory per GPU and 9.2% shorter mean iteration time than DMD.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion and flow models produce high-quality videos through repeated network evaluations ( Brooks et al., 2024 , Google DeepMind, 2025 , Wan et al., 2025 , Seedance et al., 2026 ) .
Streaming generation incurs this cost for every new block, making few-step sampling particularly valuable for long sequences.
Distillation reduces the number of evaluations ( Song et al., 2023 , Salimans and Ho, 2022 , Zheng et al., 2025b ) , while the resulting generator must preserve visual quality, maintain characters and scenes, and respond to changing instructions. Figure 1 shows APEX video examples of object interaction and storytelling.
blocks.zh:
传播和流媒体模式通过反复的网络评价产生高质量的视频(Brooks等人,2024年;Google DeepMind,2025年;Wan等人,2025年;Seedance等人,2026年)。
水流生成对每一个新的区块都会产生这种成本,使几步取样对长序特别有价值。
消沉会减少评价数量(Song et al., 2023, Salimans and Ho, 2022, Zheng et al., 2025b),而由此产生的生成器必须保持视觉质量,保持人物和场景,并响应不断变化的指令. 图1显示了APEX视频中物体交互和故事描述的例子.

blocks.en:
Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises generated samples through the difference between reference and generated-distribution scores ( Yin et al., 2024b , Yin et al., 2024a ) .
A frozen pretrained teacher supplies the reference estimate, while a separate fake-score network learns from current generator outputs.
For large video backbones, maintaining this auxiliary network adds training memory and computation.
Its estimate must also track the generator as the output distribution changes, requiring coordination of their optimization settings and updates.
This motivates learning the fake estimate within the generator.
blocks.zh:
分布匹配消化(DMD)通过参考分数和生成分配分数的差值来监督生成的样品(Yin等人,2024b;Yin等人,2024a).
一个被冻结的预先训练的教师提供参考估计数,而一个单独的假分数网络则从目前的生成器输出中学习.
对于大型视频骨干,维护这个辅助网络会增加训练内存和计算.
它的估计还必须随着产出分布的变化跟踪生成器,需要协调其优化设置和更新.
这促使在生成器中学习假估计.

blocks.en:
TwinFlow ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) and the original APEX ( Liu et al., 2026c ) show how generation and distribution estimation can share a network.
We extend APEX’s condition shifting to streaming video: the original text condition selects generation, and its shifted version selects a fake estimator trained on outputs for the same prompt.
The two roles share model parameters and, by default, optimizer states, while a separate frozen pretrained teacher provides the same reference guidance as in S2-Avatar.

我们扩展APEQQs条件切换到流媒体视频:原始文本条件选择生成,其变换的版本选择一个在输出上受过训练的假估计器,用于同一快速.
两个角色共享模型参数,默认为优化器状态,而一个单独的冷冻预训老师提供与S2-Avatar相同的参考指导.

blocks.en:
Streaming video requires the estimator to track outputs generated with a causal history.
We integrate condition shifting into S2-Avatar’s Self-Replay Forcing (SRF), which trains on replayed segments of the model’s own generated sequences ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
The shared fake estimator is fitted to these replay outputs, and its clean-latent predictions are compared with those of the frozen teacher to construct a detached correction for the generator.
We retain S2’s replay procedure and perceptual regularization, as described in Section 3 .

共享的假估测器适合这些重播输出,其干净的相对预测与冷冻师的预测进行对比,为生成器构建一个独立的校正.
正如第3节所述,我们保留了S2的重播程序和概念规范。

blocks.en:
We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos through a 70-case human study and all 320 StreamAV-Bench scenarios.
Relative to S2-Avatar, APEX receives positive net human preference for instruction following, consistency, and video quality, and achieves higher video instruction-fulfillment scores and visual aesthetics on both benchmark tracks.
A separate measurement under matched training settings shows 4.4 % 4.4\% lower peak allocated GPU memory and 9.2 % 9.2\% shorter mean iteration time than DMD.
Instruction-following preference also remains positive at 2 backbone NFE. Section 4 also reports audiovisual synchronization, motion quality, and usability.

相对于S2-Avatar,APEX获得正面的人类净偏好,对遵循,一致性,和视频质量的指令,并在两个基准轨道上实现更高的视频指令-实现分数和视觉美学.
在匹配的训练设置下单独测量显示,分配的GPU内存的峰值为4.4%,平均重迭时间比DMD短9.2%。
遵循教学的偏好在两个主干非常规外线上也仍然是积极的。 第4节还报告了视听同步、运动质量和可用性。

blocks.en: The paper makes three contributions to few-step streaming video generation: 1. Shared-network estimation through condition shifting. We learn the fake velocity within the generator while retaining a frozen reference teacher and removing the independent fake network. 2. Integration with Self-Replay Forcing. We apply condition-shifted estimation to the outputs of S2’s Self-Replay Forcing, retaining its replay procedure and perceptual regularization. 3. Video quality and training efficiency. We evaluate 180-second generation on 70 paired cases and all 320 StreamAV-Bench scenarios, alongside training-cost and sampling comparisons.

Following S2 ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , we generate a detached autoregressive rollout ( Huang et al., 2026a ) and re-noise a sampled segment with diffusion forcing (DF) ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
One differentiable causal pass processes this segment, with each block reading preceding blocks at their replay noise levels.
This allows cross-block gradients within the segment while keeping the external history and original rollout detached.
We retain S2’s teacher and perceptual regularization ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) and replace DMD’s fake estimator ( Yin et al., 2024b , Yin et al., 2024a ) through condition shifting in Section 3 .

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate 180-second streaming generation on ten StreamAV-Bench metrics and five human-preference dimensions, complemented by absolute ratings, usability, and training-cost and sampling comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们评价180秒流流层的10个StreamAV-Bench度量衡和5个人类偏好维度,辅之以绝对评分、可用性以及培训成本和抽样比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We reuse S2-Avatar’s complete training data and preparation pipeline ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , including filtering and annotation, for livestreams, talking heads, film and television, solo dance, and 2D/3D animation, as summarized in Appendix C . APEX uses its causal audiovisual backbone and Self-Replay Forcing, sharing parameters and, by default, AdamW states for generator and fake updates.
blocks.zh: 我们重新使用S2-Avatar的完整训练数据和准备管道(Zhang等人,2026年c),包括过滤和注释,用于活流、说话头、电影和电视、独奏舞蹈和2D/3D动画,附录C对此进行了总结。 APEX使用其因果视听主干和自重推进,共享参数,默认情况下,AdamW状态用于生成器和假更新。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, both models use 3 backbone denoising function evaluations (NFE) per generated block, excluding KV-cache encoding and updates. The common one-step 2 × 2\times spatial Refiner is counted separately. StreamAV-Bench outputs have resolution 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 .
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,两种模型每个生成块使用3个主干调功能评价(NFE),不包括KV-cache编码和更新. 常见的单步2×2\时空炼油器分别计算. StreamAV-Bench的产出有1344×768 1344\time768号决议.

blocks.en: Following the experimental setup of Vidu S2 ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , we use all 160 Progressive and 160 Interactive scenarios of StreamAV-Bench ( Liu et al., 2026f ) . The metrics cover instruction fulfillment (VIF, AIF), visual quality and aesthetics (VQ, VA), audio quality (AQ, PQ), audiovisual alignment and synchronization (AVAlign, AVSync), and subject and background consistency (SC, BC). All metrics are higher-is-better except AVSync, which measures temporal offset error in seconds. The 12-model comparison uses Progressive cases for VIF, AIF, SC, and BC, and both tracks for the remaining metrics.
blocks.zh: 在Vidu S2(Zhang等人,2026c)的实验设置之后,我们使用了StrewAV-Bench(刘等人,2026f)的所有160个进步和160个互动情景. 衡量标准包括指令实现(VIF、AIF)、视觉质量和美学(VQ、VA)、音频质量(AQ、PQ)、视听协调和同步(AVALING、AVSync)以及主题和背景一致性(SC、BC)。 除AVSync外,所有度量标准都是更高等的,AVSync用秒测量时间抵消错误. 12模式的比较采用VIF、AIF、SC和BC的渐进型案例,其余的衡量标准则采用两种轨迹。

blocks.en: We invited experts with backgrounds in art or aesthetics to provide preference ratings for 70 pairs of image-to-video (I2V) sequences across five dimensions: consistency, instruction following, audiovisual synchronization, video quality, and motion quality. Good/Same/Bad (GSB) denote wins, ties, and losses relative to S2-Avatar at 3 NFE. Net preference is 100 ​ ( G − B ) / 70 100(G-B)/70 , retaining ties in the denominator. Usability requires Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) above 2 for both instruction following and synchronization.
blocks.zh: 我们邀请有艺术或美学背景的专家为70对图像到视频(I2V)序列提供优先评分,这些序列涉及五个方面:一致性、随后的指导、视听同步、视频质量和运动质量。 Good/Same/Bad(GSB)在3 NFE中表示与S2-Avatar相比的胜负,关系和损失. 净偏好为100(G-B)/70100(G-B)/70,保留分母中的联系. 可用性要求对后续指示和同步指示设定高于2的平均值分数。

blocks.en: APEX ranks first on VA, VIF, and AIF and second on VQ among the 12 models with available results in Table 1 . In Table 2 , VIF, AIF, and VA improve on both tracks, with Progressive VIF and AIF increasing by 0.025 and 0.067. VQ rises on Progressive ( + 0.049 +0.049 ) but falls on Interactive ( − 0.070 -0.070 ), yielding − 0.011 -0.011 overall. BC shows the opposite track-level pattern. AQ, AVAlign, and SC decrease on both tracks, pooled PQ is effectively unchanged, and pooled AVSync error rises from 1.319 to 1.341 s. These results show instruction and aesthetic gains alongside visual and audiovisual trade-offs.

Default sampling has the highest instruction preference at both budgets in Table 4 , reaching + 27.1 % +27.1\% at 2 NFE and + 21.4 % +21.4\% at 3 NFE. Other dimensions vary across both inference budgets, with no consistent advantage from favoring lower-noise replay.
blocks.zh: 我们改变了重播时间的抽样(0.75,0.9375,0.99),使得t ' t^{\prime的得分时间表保持不变。 默认使用等重,而DF4和DF10则使用(4,1,1,1)和(10,1,1,1),(10,1,1,1),将绘制最低噪声的概率从1/3 1/3提高到2/3 2/3和5/6 5/6. 样本时间在不同的传球之前沿着重播段排序. 默认采样在表4的两种预算中都具有最高的指令偏好,在2 NFE时达到+27.1% +27.1\%,在3 NFE时达到+21.4% +21.4\%. 其他维度因两个推论预算而异,偏爱低噪音重播没有一贯的优势.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: APEX integrates condition-shifted fake estimation into S2’s Self-Replay Forcing, sharing generator and fake parameters while retaining the frozen teacher. It improves instruction fulfillment and visual aesthetics, with positive human preference for instruction following at both 3 and 2 backbone NFE. Matched measurements show lower peak allocated GPU memory and shorter mean iteration time. Motion quality and audiovisual synchronization remain trade-offs, while APEX and S2-Avatar achieve the same usability rate.
blocks.zh: APEX将条件变换假估计整合到S2的自重推进,共享生成器和假参数,同时保留被冻结的老师. 它改进了教学的实现和视觉美学,人类在3号和2号主干线非正规教育中都积极偏爱教学。 匹配的测量显示分配的GPU内存的峰值较低,平均重迭时间较短. 运动质量和视听同步仍然是取舍,而APEX和S2-Avatar的可用率相同。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: A.1 Consistency and Trajectory-Based Generation
blocks.zh: A.1 一致性和基于轨迹的生成

blocks.en:
Diffusion ( Ho et al., 2020 , Song et al., 2020 , Karras et al., 2022 ) and flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2022 ) generate samples by integrating a learned velocity field from noise to data.
Embedded Representation Warmup ( Liu et al., 2025a ) improves training efficiency by aligning early model layers with a pretrained encoder before full generative training.
Consistency and trajectory-based methods train the model to predict over a time interval, allowing generation with fewer network evaluations.
Consistency Models (CMs) ( Song et al., 2023 , Lu and Song, 2024 ) learn to map points on the same trajectory to a common endpoint.
Score-regularized continuous-time consistency (rCM) combines consistency training with score-based distribution matching for large-scale diffusion distillation ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) .
MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2025 ) predicts the average velocity over an interval, while Transition Models (TiM) ( Wang et al., 2025 ) learn the transition between its endpoints.
DuMo ( Sun et al., 2026b ) jointly predicts local velocity and a flow map with two heads on a shared backbone.
UCGM ( Sun et al., 2025b ) interpolates between generative training objectives.
blocks.zh:
扩散(Ho等人,2020年;Song等人,2020年;Karras等人,2022年)和流量匹配(Lipman等人,2022年)通过集成从噪声到数据的学习速度场生成样本.
嵌入式代表器Warmup(Liu等人,2025a)通过在全基因化训练前将早期模型层与预先训练的编码器对齐,提高了训练效率.
一致性和基于轨迹的方法对模型进行了培训,以在一个时间间隔内进行预测,从而能够生成较少的网络评价。
一致性模型(CMs)(Song et al., 2023, Lu and Song, 2024)学习将同一轨迹上的点映射到一个共同的终点.
分数规范的连续时间一致性(rCM)结合了一致性培训与基于分数的分布匹配,用于大规模扩散蒸馏(郑等人,2025b).
MeanFlow(Geng等人,2025年)预测一个间隔的平均速度,而过渡模型(Timage Models)(Wang等人,2025年)则学习其终点之间的过渡.
DuMo (Sun et al., 2026b) 联合预测本地速度和流图,共享骨干上有两个头.
UCGM(Sun等人,2025b)在基因培养目标之间插图.

blocks.en: A.2 Distribution Matching and Adversarial Training
blocks.zh: A.2 分配匹配和横向培训

blocks.en: Few-step generation also benefits from direct feedback on the generated distribution.
blocks.zh: 很少有步骤生成者也受益于对生成的分布的直接反馈。

blocks.en:
External correction signals can come from auxiliary score models, as in distribution matching ( Yin et al., 2024b , Yin et al., 2024a ) , or from discriminators used in adversarial refiners ( Kim et al., 2023 , Sauer et al., 2024 , Zheng et al., 2025a ) .
Additional networks increase memory use and update cost. Some early distillation methods also use precomputed teacher-student pairs for regularization, while DMD2 removes that paired-data requirement ( Yin et al., 2024a ) .
Direct Discriminative Optimization (DDO) ( Zheng et al., 2025a ) expresses the GAN discriminator as a likelihood ratio constructed from the target and a fixed reference model.
blocks.zh:
外部校正信号可以来自辅助分数模型,如分布比对(Yin等人,2024b,Yin等人,2024a),或者来自对抗性精炼厂所使用的歧视者. (Kim等人,2023年;Sauer等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2025年a).
额外的网络增加了内存的使用和更新成本. 一些早期的蒸馏方法也使用预算的师生配对进行规范化,而DMD2则取消了配对数据要求(Yin等人,2024a). 。 。 。
直接歧视优化(DDO)(郑等人,2025年a)表示GAN歧视者是从目标中构建的可能性比和固定的参考模型.

blocks.en:
TwinFlow ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) learns real and fake trajectories within a shared model and uses their velocity discrepancy to construct an internal correction signal.
LLaDA-Image Turbo ( Chen et al., 2026a ) adapts TwinFlow-based distillation to support image generation in two to four sampling steps.
blocks.zh:
TwinFlow(Cheng等人,2026年)在共享模型中学习真假轨迹,并利用其速度差异构建内部校正信号.
LLaDA-图像涡轮 (Chen et al., 2026a) 调整双花基蒸馏,支持图像生成,分两至四个采样步骤.

blocks.en: APEX ( Liu et al., 2026c ) follows this line and separates the branches through condition shifting. The shifted condition selects the fake estimator for samples generated with the original prompt. In Section 3.2 , our video formulation shares generator and fake parameters while retaining S2’s frozen reference teacher.
blocks.zh: APEX(Liu et al., 2026c)遵循这条线,通过条件转移分离分支. 转动条件选择了假的估测器,用于原速生成的样本. 在3.2节,我们的视频配方共享发电机和假参数,同时保留S2的冷冻参考老师.

blocks.en: Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM) ( Liu et al., 2026a ) adds feature mean and standard deviation matching to DMD using the generator’s exponential moving average (EMA) copy.
blocks.zh: Intrinsic Distribution Matching(IDM)(Liu等人,2026年a)利用生成器的指数移动平均值(EMA)副本,添加了特征平均值和标准偏差匹配DMD.

blocks.en: Few-step score identity distillation (SiD) ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) also studies how conditioning affects distribution matching. Its Zero-CFG strategy removes text conditioning from the fake-score network, while Anti-CFG applies negative classifier-free guidance by combining conditional and unconditional predictions. These strategies modify the fake-score estimate. APEX fits the fake velocity under shifted text.
blocks.zh: 少步积分身份蒸馏法(SiD)(周 et等人,2025年)也研究了条件如何影响分布匹配. 它的Zero-CFG策略取消了假分数网络的文本调制,而Anti-CFG则通过结合有条件和无条件的预测来应用负分解无导. 这些策略修改了假分数估计. APEX 符合变换文本下的假速度.

blocks.en:
Fake-Score-network-Free DMD (FSF-DMD) ( Kim et al., 2026a ) replaces the auxiliary fake-score network with a generator-induced endpoint pseudo-velocity. APEX instead learns the fake velocity through flow matching on generated samples under a shifted condition.
TBSM ( Sun et al., 2026a ) constructs regression targets from attraction to real samples and repulsion from generated samples under an energy-distance objective; its correction is defined by sample interactions rather than a real/fake velocity difference.
blocks.zh:
Fake-Score-network-Free DMD(FSF-DMD)(Kim等人,2026a)用发电机引起的端点伪高速取代了辅助假分网. APEX转而通过在变换条件下对生成的样品进行流量匹配来学习假速度.
TBSM(Sun等人,2026a)在能量-距离目标下构建从吸引到真实样本的回归目标,并从生成的样本中进行回转;其校正由样本相互作用而不是真实/假速度差异来定义.

blocks.en: A.3 Causal Streaming Video
blocks.zh: A.3 因果流视频

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video diffusion has been studied through asynchronous generation ( Sun et al., 2025a ) , progressive prediction ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , and causal generation with cache sharing ( Gao et al., 2025a ) .
MAGI-1 studies autoregressive generation at scale ( Teng et al., 2025 ) , while SkyReels-V2 targets extended video generation ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
FIFO-Diffusion ( Kim et al., 2024 ) and StreamingT2V ( Henschel et al., 2025 ) also investigate extending video generation beyond a short clip.
Later predictions depend on generated history.
blocks.zh:
通过同步生成(Sun等人,2025年a),渐进预测(Xie等人,2025年),以及缓存共享的因果生成(Gao等人,2025年a),对自动回归视频传播进行了研究。 。 。 。
MAGI-1在规模上研究自递生成(Teng等人,2025年),而SkyReels-V2则瞄准扩展视频生成(Chen等人,2025年).
FIFO-Diffusion(Kim等人,2024年)和StreatingT2V(Henschel等人,2025年)也调查了将视频生成扩展至短片以外的内容.
以后的预测取决于生成的历史.

blocks.en:
CausVid distills bidirectional video diffusion into an autoregressive model ( Yin et al., 2025 ) ; diagonal distillation provides another streaming autoregressive formulation ( Liu et al., 2026d ) .
Causal Forcing and Causal Forcing++ study few-step autoregressive distillation for real-time interaction ( Zhu et al., 2026a , Zhao et al., 2026b ) .
Causal-rCM unifies Teacher Forcing and Self Forcing in a streaming distillation recipe ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
LPM studies video-based character performance ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , providing a setting for distribution matching in autoregressive models that animate characters.
blocks.zh:
CausVid将双向视频扩散成自旋模型(Yin等人,2025年);对角蒸馏提供了另一种流式自旋配体(Liu等人,2026d).
Causal Forcing and Causal Forcing++ 研究几步自旋蒸馏进行实时相互作用(Zhu等人,2026a,Zhao等人,2026b).
Causal-rCM 在流水蒸馏配方中统一教师强制和自我强制(郑等人,2026年).
LPM研究基于视频的人物性能(Zeng等人,2026年),为自动递归模型中的发行匹配提供了设定,使人物动画化.

blocks.en:
S2-Avatar ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) combines bidirectional reference-conditioned training, causal adaptation with Teacher and Diffusion Forcing, and Self-Replay Forcing.
Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) exposes the model to noisy historical states, while Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026a ) trains with autoregressive histories generated by the current model.
S2’s replay procedure retains cross-block gradients inside a sampled trajectory segment without retaining the full rollout graph.
APEX uses this video setting to learn the fake estimator within the generator while retaining S2’s causal replay procedure and reference teacher.
FlowCPO ( Han et al., 2026 ) studies offline preference alignment using fixed preferred and dispreferred samples.
Preference optimization and latent refinement are separate from the APEX correction.
blocks.zh:
S2-Avatar(Zhang等人,2026c)结合了双向参考条件训练,因果调适与教师与传播强化,自重游戏强制.
扩散福尔克星(Chen等人,2024年)使该型号暴露于吵闹的历史状态下,而Self Forcing(Huang等人,2026a年)列车则具有由目前型号产生的自转历史.
S2的重播程序在采样的轨迹段内保留了交叉块梯度,而不保留完整的推出图.
APEX 使用此视频设置在生成器内学习假估计器,同时保留 S2 的因果重播程序和参考老师.
FlowCPO(Han等人,2026年)利用固定偏好和偏好样本研究离线偏好调整。
优惠优化和潜在完善与APEX修正是分开的.

blocks.en: A.4 Historical Context and Long Video Generation
blocks.zh: A.4 历史背景和长视频生成

blocks.en:
History-Guided Video Diffusion studies conditioning on past video ( Song et al., 2025 ) , while Grounded Forcing separates persistent semantics from recent dynamics ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025a ) and Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2025b ) target real-time long video generation; Infinity-RoPE investigates action control under autoregressive self-rollout ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ) .
UltraViCo ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) addresses length extrapolation by suppressing attention dispersion beyond the training window, providing a complementary approach to extending video duration.
These works motivate evaluating instruction response and motion quality alongside visual appearance as a stream grows longer.
blocks.zh:
History-Guided Video Difusion Research 校对:Soup
LongLive(Yang等人,2025a)和Rolling Forcing(Liu等人,2025b)的目标是实时长视频生成;Infinity-RoPE在自动自滚(Yeiltepe等人,2026)下调查动作控制.
UltraViCo(Zhao等人,2026年a)通过抑制注意力在培训窗口外的分散,解决长度推算问题,为延长视频时间提供了补充方法.
这些作品激励人们评价教学反应和运动质量,同时随着一个溪流的延长而出现视觉。

blocks.en:
Memory design provides a complementary approach.
SWIFT uses prompt-adaptive memory ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , IAMFlow studies identity-aware memory ( Liu et al., 2026e ) , and FramePack compresses the input-frame context for next-frame prediction ( Zhang and Agrawala, 2025 ) .
Deep Forcing uses sink states and compression ( Yi et al., 2025 ) ; Rolling Sink studies the gap between limited training horizons and open-ended testing ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
MemRoPE uses evolving memory tokens for extended generation ( Kim et al., 2026b ) .
Attention sinks were also studied for streaming language models ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) ; S2 adopts sink blocks within its video context design ( Zhang et al., 2026d , Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
APEX retains this context design for its shared model.
Quant VideoGen ( Xi et al., 2026 ) reduces autoregressive history-storage costs through two-bit KV-cache quantization, using semantic-aware smoothing and progressive residual quantization.
ViewRope ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) instead injects camera-ray geometry into rotary position embeddings and selects relevant historical frames to improve spatial consistency in camera-controlled video world models.
These methods address history storage and retrieval, complementing APEX’s focus on the training cost of distribution estimation.
blocks.zh:
内存设计提供了一个互补的方法.
SWIFT使用即时适应记忆(Tan等人,2026年),IAM Flow研究身份意识记忆(Liu等人,2026e),FramePack压缩下一帧预测的输入框背景(Zhang和Agrawala,2025).
Deep Forcing使用沉淀状态和压缩(Yi等人,2025年);Rolling Sink研究有限训练视野与开放式测试之间的差距(Li等人,2026年b).
MemROPE使用进化的内存符号进行扩展生成(Kim等人,2026b.).
还研究了溪流语言模型的注意力汇(Xiao等人,2024年);S2在其视频背景设计中采用汇块(Zhang等人,2026d,Zhang等人,2026c.).
APEX为其共享模型保留了这种上下文设计.
Quant VideoGen(Xi et al., 2026)通过双位KV-cache解析法,使用语义感知平滑和渐进式残余解析法,降低自旋历史存储成本.
ViewRope(Xiang等人,2026年)转而将相机射线几何注入旋转位置嵌入,并选择相关历史帧,以提高相机控制视频世界模型的空间一致性.
这些方法涉及历史的存储和检索,是对APEX’s的补充,侧重于发行估计的培训成本.

blocks.en:
For streaming video understanding, ChronoReplay ( Hu et al., 2026a ) organizes heterogeneous spatial supervision into chronological episodes, while Supervising the Visible State ( Hu et al., 2026b ) separates supervision of temporal state from adaptive selection of visual evidence.
These studies provide complementary context for the role of temporal supervision and historical evidence in streaming video understanding.
blocks.zh:
对于流传的视频理解,ChronoReplay(Hu等人,2026a)将不同的空间监督组织成时间顺序的片段,而监督显性状态(Hu等人,2026b)则将时态监督与视觉证据的适应性选择分开.
这些研究为时间监督和历史证据在流媒体视频理解中的作用提供了补充背景.

blocks.en: A.5 Audio-Driven and Interactive Video
blocks.zh: A.5 音频驱动和互动视频

blocks.en:
Audio-driven character generation includes portrait animation with Hallo3 ( Cui et al., 2025 ) , body animation with OmniAvatar ( Gan et al., 2025 ) , and cinematic video with Wan-S2V ( Gao et al., 2025b ) .
StableAvatar studies extended audio-driven generation ( Tu et al., 2025 ) .
Live Avatar ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , SoulX-FlashTalk ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , and AptAvatar ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) address real-time or long-form avatar generation.
AvatarForcing specifically studies one-step streaming talking avatars ( Cui et al., 2026 ) .
Joint audio and video generation is studied by OmniForcing ( Su et al., 2026b ) , Hallo-Live ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and Omni-LiveAvatar ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) .
TurboT2VA ( Yang et al., 2026 ) extends consistency distillation to joint video-audio generation with modality-specific normalization and a progressive curriculum that introduces distribution matching after consistency training.
This connects few-step distillation to audiovisual synchronization, although its joint-generation setting differs from the causal replay setting studied here.
Comparisons must distinguish joint audio generation from video generation conditioned on fixed external audio.
blocks.zh:
音效驱动的角色生成包括Hallo3的肖像动画(Cui等人,2025年),OmniAvatar的体动画(Gan等人,2025年),以及Wan-S2V的影视(Gao等人,2025年b).
StableAvatar研究扩展音频驱动生成(Tu等人,2025年).
Live Avatar (Huang等人,2025年), SoulX-FlashTalk (Shen等人,2025年),以及AptAvatar (Zhang等人,2026年a) 解决实时或长形异形一代.
AvatarForcing专门研究了单步流传的说话avatars(Cui等人,2026年).
OmniForcing(Su等人,2026年b),Hallo-Live(Li等人,2026年a)和Omni-LiveAvatar研究了联合音频和视频生成。 (朱等,2026b).
TurboT2VA(Yang等人,2026年)将一致性蒸馏推广到具有特定模式正常化的视频-音频联合生成,并采用在一致性培训后引入分布匹配的渐进式课程.
这将几步蒸馏与视听同步联系起来,尽管其联合生成设定与这里研究的因果重播设定不同.
比较必须区分联合音频生成与以固定外部音频为条件的视频生成.

blocks.en:
S2’s evaluation also includes external systems such as PixVerse R1 ( PixVerse, 2026 ) , HappyOyster ( Alibaba, 2026 ) , Odyssey-2 ( Odyssey, 2025 ) , and HeyGen ( HeyGen, 2026 ) .
Their inclusion in S2 provides evaluation context; the APEX evidence here consists of the internal I2V comparison and the completed StreamAV-Bench run in Section 4 .
Comparisons must match references, audio, duration, and resolution.
blocks.zh:
S2的评价还包括PixVerse R1(PixVerse,2026),HappyOyster等外部系统. (阿里巴巴,2026年),奥德赛-2(奥德赛,2025年),HeyGen(HeyGen,2026年).
将它们列入S2提供了评价背景;这里的APEX证据包括内部的I2V比较和完成的第4节StrewAV-Bench运行.
比较必须匹配引用,音频,持续时间和分辨率.

blocks.en: A.6 Efficient Video Inference
blocks.zh: A.6 高效视频推论

blocks.en:
Sampling steps are one component of generation cost.
TurboDiffusion accelerates video diffusion ( Zhang et al., 2025h ) , and TurboServe addresses efficient streaming service ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
Pyramidal Flow Matching studies efficient video generation across scales ( Jin et al., 2025 ) ; the present experiments account separately for the low-resolution backbone and one-step high-resolution spatial Refiner.
blocks.zh:
取样步骤是发电成本的一个组成部分。
TurboDifusion加速视频传播(Zhang等人,2025h),TurboServe解决高效的流线服务(Jiang等人,2026).
Pyramidal Flow Matching研究跨尺度高效视频生成(Jin等人,2025年);目前的实验分别核算低分辨率主干线和一步高分辨率空间炼油器.

blocks.en:
Efficient attention methods can be organized into hardware-efficient, sparse, compact, and linear approaches ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
Sparse VideoGen ( Xi et al., 2025 ) exploits spatial and temporal attention-head patterns, while Sparse VideoGen2 ( Yang et al., 2025b ) uses semantic-aware token permutation to identify and group important attention blocks.
SVG-EAR ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) complements sparse computation with parameter-free centroid compensation and error-aware routing for skipped blocks.
blocks.zh:
高效的注意方法可以组织成高硬件效率,稀疏,紧凑,线性的方法(Zhang等人,2025b.).
Sparse VideoGen(Xi等人,2025年)利用空间和时间关注头模式,而Sparse VideoGen2(Yang等人,2025年b)则使用语义感知符号穿插来识别和分组重要的关注块.
SVG-EAR(Zhou等人,2026年)以无参数的中间行星补偿和对跳过块的误觉路由来补充稀疏的计算.

blocks.en:
S2’s attention implementation draws on several families of efficient operators.
SageAttention and SageAttention2 use low-bit attention ( Zhang et al., 2025e , Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; SageAttention2++ improves its implementation ( Zhang et al., 2025g ) , and SageAttention3 explores FP4 inference and low-bit training ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) .
SageBwd further studies trainable low-bit attention ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
SpargeAttention studies sparse attention without additional training ( Zhang et al., 2025f ) , while SpargeAttention2 uses trainable masking and distillation ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) .
SLA and SLA2 combine sparse and linear attention. SLA2 incorporates learnable routing together with quantization-aware training ( Zhang et al., 2025c , Zhang et al., 2026f ) .
blocks.zh:
S2的注意力执行吸引了几个高效运营商的家庭.
SageAtenty和SageAtenty2使用低位关注(张等,2025e,张等,2025a);SageAtenty2++改进实施(张等,2025g),SageAtenty3探索FP4推论和低位培训(张等,2025d).
SageBwd进一步研究可训练低位关注(张等,2026b.
SpargeAttention在未接受额外培训的情况下很少受到重视(Zhang等人,2025f),而SpargeAttenty2则使用可训练的面具和蒸馏(Zhang等人,2026e).
苏丹解放军和苏丹解放军2派将注意力分散和线性结合起来。 SLA2将可学习的路由与量化-认知训练结合起来(Zhang等人,2025c,Zhang等人,2026f).

blocks.en:
At the linear-layer level, 6Bit-Diffusion ( Su et al., 2026a ) dynamically allocates NVFP4 and INT8 precision according to quantization sensitivity and reuses temporally stable block residuals.
Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Video Generation ( Hu and Zhang, 2026 ) uses a smaller model to draft video blocks and a quality router to decide which blocks require regeneration by the larger target model.
Both affect inference computation, a separate consideration from the number of networks maintained during distillation.
blocks.zh:
在线性层次上,6Bit-Difusion(Su等人,2026a)根据定量灵敏度和再利用时间稳定的块残基,动态分配NVFP4和INT8精度.
自动递归视频生成(Hu and Zhang, 2026)的Speculation Drooding使用一个较小的模型来起草视频块,以及一个质量路由器来决定哪些块需要由更大的目标模型再生.
两者都影响推论计算,与蒸馏过程中维持的网络数量是分开考虑的.

blocks.en:
S2 also draws on block-level low-bit computation ( Zhang et al., 2025i ) and Ulysses-style parallelism ( Jacobs et al., 2023 ) .
These operators, precision choices, and parallel schedules can change latency at the same NFE. The training-cost comparison in Figure 5 measures APEX and DMD under matched settings.
blocks.zh:
S2还借鉴了块级低位计算(张等人,2025i)和尤利西斯风格的平行论(雅各布等人,2023年).
这些运算符,精准选择,以及平行的排程,可以改变同一非FE的耐久性. 图5中的培训费用比较在相应的环境下衡量APEX和DMD。

blocks.en: A.7 Streaming Video Editing
blocks.zh: A.7 流媒体编辑

blocks.en:
StreamDiffusionV2 studies dynamic interactive video generation ( Feng et al., 2025 ) .
LiveEdit ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , JoyAI-Video-Edit ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , and SANA-Streaming ( Zhao et al., 2026c ) address streaming video editing.
These methods use an incoming video’s motion and structure, which differs from I2V conditioning.

流体分散 V2研究动态互动视频生成(冯等人,2025年).
LiveEdit(Wang等人,2026年),JoyAI-Video-Edit(Xiao等人,2026年),SANA-Streaming(Zhao等人,2026年c)地址流视频编辑.
这些方法使用传入的视频的运动和结构,这与I2V调制不同.

blocks.en:
StreamEval ( StreamEval Team, 2026 ) evaluates timed interactions across avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing, measuring task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination.
Our reported benchmark results use StreamAV-Bench ( Liu et al., 2026f ) and do not include StreamEval measurements.

StreamEval(StreamEval Team,2026)评价跨avatar对话、avatar性能、世界生成、指令编辑和参考编辑、任务执行计量、状态一致性、视觉忠诚度和视听协调的定时互动。
我们报告的基准结果采用StreamAV-Bench(Liu等人,2026f),不包括StreamEval测量。

blocks.en:
VTR-Bench ( Huang et al., 2026b ) evaluates visual text fidelity separately from scene and motion requirements in video.
UltraText Bench ( Liu et al., 2026b ) evaluates dense bilingual text in individual images, providing complementary background on visual text rendering.
Neither is evaluated here.

VTR-Bench(Huang等人,2026年b)在视频中将视觉文本的忠诚度与场景和运动要求分开评价.
UltraText Beach (Liu et al., 2026b)评价个人图像中密集的双语文本,为视觉文本渲染提供了补充背景.
这里也没有评估。

blocks.en:
We reuse the complete S2-Avatar training data and preparation pipeline, including filtering and annotation ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
The data include livestream and talking-head videos, film and television, solo dance, and 2D/3D animation, covering facial expressions, body motion, and animated characters. Figure 8 summarizes the data pipeline inherited from Vidu S1 ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) .
blocks.zh:
我们重新使用完整的S2-Avatar培训数据和准备管道,包括过滤和注释(Zhang等人,2026c)。
数据包括直播流和谈话头像,电影和电视,独舞,以及2D/3D动画,涵盖面部表情,身体运动,以及动画人物. 图8总结了从Vidu S1继承的数据管道(张等,2026d.).

blocks.en:
Single-shot clips are filtered for subject visibility, visual quality, content safety, shot stability, and interactivity.
Smooth camera motion is corrected using background features after masking foreground subjects; clips with large or complex camera motion are excluded.
Full-clip and event-aligned chunk captions describe actions and outcomes chronologically, using object detection and speech recognition to ground the annotations.
The clipping, quality checks, background stabilization, and annotation procedures follow S2 without changes; APEX modifies only the model training procedure, as described in Section 3 .
blocks.zh:
单发片段被过滤,以达到主题可见度,视觉质量,内容安全,镜头稳定性,以及交互性.
平滑相机运动在遮掩前缘主体后使用背景特征进行校正;片段带有大型或复杂相机运动的片段除外.
完全剪切和事件相匹配的块标题按时间顺序描述动作和结果,使用对象检测和语音识别来对说明进行定位.
如第3节所述,剪辑、质量检查、背景稳定和注释程序遵循S2,未作改动;APEX只修改示范培训程序。

blocks.en: We detail the evaluators, aggregation rules, and comparison budgets for Section 4.2 and Section 4.3 .

blocks.en: D.1 StreamAV-Bench
blocks.zh: D.1 流线车-奔驰

blocks.en:
We evaluate all 320 StreamAV-Bench cases ( Liu et al., 2026f ) : 160 Progressive and 160 Interactive scenarios, using 180-second outputs.
The Interactive track introduces five runtime condition updates at 30-second intervals, at 30, 60, 90, 120, and 150 seconds.
We measure APEX and S2-Avatar. Other models’ VIF scores are from StreamAV-Bench ( Liu et al., 2026f ) , with other scores from Vidu S2 ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh:
我们利用180秒的产出,评估所有320 StreamAV-Bench案件(Liu等人,2026f):160个进步设想和160个互动设想。
互动赛道以30秒间隔,30,60,90,120,150秒,引入5个运行时间条件更新.
我们测量APEX和S2-Avatar. 其他型号的VIF分数来自StreamAV-Bench(刘等人,2026f),其他分数来自Vidu S2(张等人,2026c).

blocks.en:
Visual Aesthetics (VA) uses the LAION Aesthetic Predictor ( LAION-AI, 2022 ) .
Visual Quality (VQ), Video Instruction Fulfillment (VIF), Audio Quality (AQ), and Audio Instruction Fulfillment (AIF) use the benchmark’s Gemini judge.
Subject Consistency (SC) and Background Consistency (BC) measure full-sequence stability.
Audio-Visual Alignment (AVAlign) uses ImageBind similarity ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) to assess cross-modal semantic agreement.
Audio-Visual Synchronization (AVSync) uses Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) to measure temporal offset error in seconds.
Production Quality (PQ) assesses the output audio with AudioBox Aesthetics ( Tjandra et al., 2025 ) .
All benchmark metrics except AVSync are higher-is-better.
blocks.zh:
视觉美学(VA)使用LAION美学先验(LAION-AI,2022年).
视觉质量(VQ),视频指令完成(VIF),音频质量(AQ),音频指令完成(AIF)使用基准的双子座裁判.
主题一致性(SC)和背景一致性(BC)测量全序列稳定性.
视听对齐(AVAlign)采用ImageBind相似性(Girdhar等人,2023年)来评估跨模式语义协议.
视听同步(AVSync)使用Synchformer(Iashin等人,2024年)以秒表示时间抵消错误.
制作质量(PQ)用AudioBox美学评估输出音频(Tjandra等人,2025年).
除AVSync外,所有基准度量标准都是比比较高的.

blocks.en:
VA, PQ, AVAlign, and AVSync are evaluated over six non-overlapping 30-second windows per video, whereas SC and BC use the full 180-second sequence.
Track summaries average case-level scores with equal weight. Overall summaries pool all 320 cases. Since the tracks have equal size, this equals the average of the two unrounded track means.
The 12-model comparison in Table 1 uses Progressive cases for VIF, AIF, SC, and BC, and both tracks for the remaining metrics. Table 2 provides track means and pooled results. Differences use unrounded APEX minus S2-Avatar scores, so a positive AVSync difference indicates worse synchronization.
blocks.zh:
VA,PQ,AVAlign,AVSync每部视频在6个非重叠30秒窗口上评价,而SC和BC则使用全部180秒序列.
轨迹汇总 平均案例级别分数相同,权重相同. 总摘要汇集了所有320个案件。 由于音轨大小相同,这等于两个未圆形音轨的平均值表示.
表1中的12种模式比较采用了VIF、AIF、SC和BC的渐进型案例,其余的衡量标准则采用了两种跟踪。 表2提供了跟踪手段和集合结果。 差异使用未圆形的APEX减S2-Avatar分数,因此正AVSync差表示同步性差.

blocks.en: D.2 Paired Human Comparisons
blocks.zh: D.2 人为比较

blocks.en:
Each comparison uses 70 paired 180-second I2V cases.
The five preference dimensions are consistency, instruction following, audiovisual synchronization, video quality, and motion quality.
Good/Same/Bad (GSB) counts wins, ties, and losses for the evaluated model relative to the reference, with G + S + B = 70 G+S+B=70 for each dimension.
Net preference is 100 ​ ( G − B ) / 70 100(G-B)/70 , retaining tied cases in the denominator. One net win therefore changes the reported preference by approximately 1.43 percentage points.
Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) assess instruction following and synchronization, with higher values indicating better quality.
A sequence is counted as usable when both scores exceed 2.
Synchronization MOS and the benchmark’s AVSync error therefore have opposite directions.
In the main study, consistency and video quality each have G/S/B counts of 13/47/10 (three net wins), whereas motion quality has 2/60/8 (six net losses), matching Figure 4 .
blocks.zh:
每次比较使用70对180秒I2V型病例.
五个偏好方面是一致性、遵循指令、视听同步、视频质量和运动质量。
Good/Same/Bad(GSB)计算得分,关系,以及评价模型相对于参考物的损失,每个维度的G+S+B=70G+S+B=70.
净偏好为100(G-B)/70100(G-B)/70,在分母中保留附带条件的案例。 因此,一个净赢家改变了所报告的偏好约1.43个百分点。
平均评分(MOS)评估指令跟随和同步,较高值显示质量更好.
当两个分数都超过2时,一个序列算作可用.
因此,同步MOS和基准的 AVSync 错误有相反的方向。
在主要研究中,一致性和视频质量各有G/S/B数13/47/10(净赢3),而运动质量有2/60/8(净输6),与图4相匹配。

blocks.en:
The main 3-NFE human study in Figure 4 and the additional sampling and training comparisons use separate evaluation rounds. Table 4 groups the latter by sampling budget and optimizer configuration.
Each additional variant is paired with S2-Avatar at 3 NFE, so differences between variants are comparisons against a common reference rather than direct pairwise judgments.
For the optimizer comparisons, shared AdamW states are evaluated at 3 NFE and separate states at 2 NFE, with model parameters shared in both settings.
All replay-time sampling variants share optimizer states and sort sampled times along the sequence. At noise levels ( 0.75 , 0.9375 , 0.99 ) (0.75,0.9375,0.99) , the default, DF4, and DF10 weights correspond to sampling probabilities ( 1 / 3 , 1 / 3 , 1 / 3 ) (1/3,1/3,1/3) , ( 2 / 3 , 1 / 6 , 1 / 6 ) (2/3,1/6,1/6) , and ( 5 / 6 , 1 / 12 , 1 / 12 ) (5/6,1/12,1/12) , respectively. DF10 favors the lowest noise level most strongly.
blocks.zh:
图4中主要的3-NFE人类研究以及额外的采样和培训比较使用单独的评价回合. 表4按抽样预算和优化配置对后者进行了分类。
每个附加的变体在3 NFE上与S2-Avatar配对,所以变体之间的区别是比较一个共同的参考而不是直接的对偶判断.
为了进行优化比较,共享的AdamW状态在3 NFE和2 NFE的单独状态上得到评价,两种设置都共享模型参数.
所有重播时间采样变体共享优化状态,沿序列排序采样时间. 在噪声水平(0.75,0.9375,0.99)下,默认值,DF4和DF10重量对应采样概率(1/3,1/3,1/3),(2/3,1/6,1/6,1/6)和(5/6,1/12,1/12),(分别为5/6,1/12,1/12). DF10最倾向于最低噪音级别.

blocks.en: D.3 Backbone and Refiner Budget
blocks.zh: D.3 后骨和炼油机预算

blocks.en:
NFE counts backbone denoising evaluations per generated video block, excluding KV-cache encoding and updates.
All paired comparisons use the same one-step spatial Refiner with 2 × 2\times upsampling, following S2 ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
The Refiner adds one separate evaluation per block to either a 2-NFE or a 3-NFE backbone.
The 2-NFE setting therefore uses one third fewer backbone evaluations, with the Refiner unchanged.
The teacher and fake estimator add no inference calls.
The replay times t i t_{i} and scoring time t ′ t^{\prime} in Section 3 are variables used during training and do not determine the inference evaluation budget.
blocks.zh:
NFE计算每个生成的视频块的主干调评价,不包括KV-cache编码和更新.
所有对齐的比较都使用相同的单步空间炼油器,2×2\时的上标,跟随S2(张等,2026c). 。 。 。
炼油厂在2NFE或3NFE主干线上每块增加一个单独的评价.
因此, " 2-NFE " 设置采用的主干评价减少三分之一,炼油厂不变。
师与假估师加无上推论.
